source: SmartNanoFormulator local literature catalogue; conservative explicit-label extraction
status: provisional prior calibration, not supervised training data
extraction_policy: Use only clearly labelled, parseable values
Exclude radii when diameter is needed
Exclude ambiguous measurement modalities and unlabelled values
Exclude PDI percentage text unless its meaning is explicitly defined as a fraction conversion
Do not treat these values as a clean ML training matrix
notes: Phytosome size and PDI anchors remain expert-informed due to sparse data
Zeta and EE point priors remain unchanged due to inconsistent signs, methods and sparse data
Most slopes, design bounds, carrier rankings and recipes remain expert judgement
